components.name: Account action
components.css: .ds-account { width:100%; background:#007a5a; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:4px; font-family:sans-serif; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-account:hover { background-image:linear-gradient(#ffffff14,#ffffff14); } .ds-account:active { background-image:linear-gradient(#ffffff24,#ffffff24); } .ds-account:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d9bd1; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Retry or Cancel uses the accent without a filled container.
components.css: .ds-text { color:#8195ff; background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:4px; font-family:sans-serif; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-text:hover { background:#ffffff14; } .ds-text:active { background:#ffffff24; } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d9bd1; }

components.name: Conversation search
components.html: <input class="ds-search" aria-label="Find a channel or conversation" placeholder="Find a channel or conversation">
components.css: .ds-search { background:#1c1d21; color:#f5f5f5; border:1px solid #5a5c61; border-radius:8px; padding:16px; font-family:sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color:#abadb1; } .ds-search:hover { border-color:#f5f5f5; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #8195ff; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Home navigation
components.description: Selected navigation in the dark Aubergine palette.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:16px; background:#1c1d21; padding:8px 16px; } .ds-nav button { color:#abadb1; background:transparent; border:0; padding:12px 16px; font-family:sans-serif; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav button[aria-current] { color:#f5f5f5; background:#713783; } .ds-nav button:hover { background-image:linear-gradient(#ffffff14,#ffffff14); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d9bd1; } .ds-nav button:active { background-image:linear-gradient(#ffffff24,#ffffff24); }

components.name: Conversation header
components.description: Tonal container for a conversation title and optional topic.
components.css: .ds-header { background:#24262a; color:#f5f5f5; border-radius:12px; padding:4px 12px; font-family:sans-serif; } .ds-header strong { display:block; font-weight:700; } .ds-header span { display:block; color:#abadb1; font-family:sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Conversations lead. Familiar Slack navigation, compact rows and clear unread states sit inside native Android controls. The workspace frame carries the chosen palette; the conversation canvas stays neutral.
keyCharacteristics: Native text scaling, Back and keyboard behavior.

rules.name: The Role Color Rule
rules.body: Read colors through `SlatrixTheme.colors`; preserve the light and dark role pairs.

rules.name: The Scaled Type Rule
rules.body: Use theme type roles and allow Android system font scaling. Do not replace them with fixed text sizes. The app inherits Material's font metrics; it has no separate display face.

dos: Do follow Slack Android conventions for supported actions and wording.
Do use shared color roles, shared radii and Android spacing tokens.
Do preserve readable foregrounds in both modes and at larger text sizes.
Do show cached content immediately and keep rows still as details arrive.
donts: Don't expose controls without a working action.
Don't replace native icons with text glyphs.
Don't cover visible content with loading UI or add loading explanations.
